gen-gf-grandstander-gf-athiti: Grandstander draws every letter with one plain, constant line, like a marker held steady. Athiti sits underneath with a high mean line and open s shapes, so the heading's loud swagger gets a tidy, friendly sans to lean on.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Grandstander looks traced with a marker, bold and expressive, with tall lowercase and short ascenders. Atkinson Hyperlegible follows with clipped capitals and wide-set terminals on its s, and that sturdy clarity is the strongest thing about the pairing.

Strokes that never swing between thick and thin give Grandstander its bold, expressive, held-open look. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono counters with stretched-out spacing and open counters, so the loud heading finds a patient, breathing partner underneath.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clean and friendly, with a big eye on every e. Grandstander is the one that gets to shout, all bold constant-width lines, while Biryani's plain sans does the quiet job of keeping small counters unclogged.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-blinker: Expressive and bold, Grandstander holds its lines at one plain width and keeps its letters open, with short ascenders up top. Blinker follows quietly, a friendly sans with lowercase filling most of its height.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-carrois-gothic: Professional is the first word for Carrois Gothic, but Grandstander gets there first with lines as steady as a drawn string. And that modern plain sans body, with its high-set x-height and generous c, gives the loud heading somewhere sensible to land.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Bold and loose in spirit, Grandstander runs lines with the flatness of a steel cable outline, no thick-thin shift anywhere. Carrois Gothic SC takes over below with clear openings at every curve and capitals barely taller than its lowercase, a contemporary sans that stays friendly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with visible daylight through every curve. And Grandstander, with its flat, unvarying line weight and bold personality, feels like the playful older sibling beside that approachable sans.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-chocolate-classic: Chocolate Classical Sans reads big and modern, its lowercase sizable and its broad-nibbed strokes never curling shut. Grandstander is the showoff here, bold lines traced with one marker tip, while the body just gets on with the sentences.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-comme: Comme gives a smooth read, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height with no clogged curves. But Grandstander is where the fun is, with pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, set above that modern plain sans.
